Plan events 6× faster. Poll dates, share a link, see live RSVPs, and settle costs automatically—everything in Nowa, totally free.

■ Why Choose Nowa

① Schedule Without the Back-and-Forth
Propose multiple dates. Let everyone vote with simple ○×△ options. See results instantly. No more "Reply All" nightmares or endless polls. The best date picks itself.

② Split Bills Like Magic
Track who paid for what. Nowa calculates exactly who owes whom. Get precise amounts for each person. Money stress? Gone.

③ Real-Time Everything
Guest lists, schedules, expenses - everything syncs instantly. No more asking "What time was that again?"

④ One Link Does It All
Share your event link anywhere. Guests join instantly with no sign-up required.

⑤ Core Features Always Free
Date scheduling, participant management, and expense splitting are completely free forever. No trial periods, no surprises - just full functionality from day one.

■ Key Features

● Event Management
- Create and edit events easily
- Add event descriptions for everyone to see
- Participant memo feature for notes and updates

● Smart Scheduling
- Add multiple date options
- Visual ○×△ voting system
- See everyone's availability at a glance
- Automatic best date suggestions

● Guest Management
- Track RSVPs effortlessly
- QR code invitations for easy sharing
- Participant profile management
- Real-time attendance updates

● Activity Timeline
- Build detailed schedules
- Set what happens when
- Add notes to schedule items
- Keep everyone on the same timeline

● Expense Splitting
- Log shared expenses
- Automatic fair split calculations
- Track payment status
- Clear settlement instructions

■ Premium Perks

Free version gives you everything you need for most events, but for power users:

- Unlimited active events (free: 3 events max)
- Unlimited participants (free: 50 people max)
- Advanced permission controls
- Ad-free experience

■ Perfect For

● Social Events: Birthday parties, potlucks, happy hours, book clubs
● Sports & Outdoors: Tailgates, hiking trips, camping weekends
● Professional: Team building, client dinners, office parties
● Special Occasions: Bachelor parties, baby showers, reunions
● Travel: Road trips, group vacations, music festivals

② Share the link with your crew
③ Let Nowa handle the coordination

• All-in-one solution - no more app switching

show_hn.title: Show HN: Nowa – No-signup event planning app for scheduling and bill splitting

quotes.text:
Ever feel exhausted by the endless back-and-forth of "When should we meet?" and "How much does everyone owe?" when organizing events with friends or family? I've been there too, and found that existing tools were either too feature-heavy or required tedious account setup.
That's why I built Nowa - an event management app focused on just the essentials that works by simply sharing a URL, no registration required.
Key Features
No-signup invitations - Just share a URL or QR code and anyone can join instantly. I prioritized simplicity so even grandparents can use it without confusion.
Intuitive scheduling - Propose multiple date options at once, participants vote with simple checkmarks, and the best date becomes clear immediately.
Automatic bill splitting - Someone covers the bill, enters the amount, and everyone's share is calculated automatically. No more "who owes what?" headaches.
Mobile-first design - Built with Flutter for iOS/Android. Smooth operation even when you're coordinating on the train.
Technical Details
Built with Flutter and Firebase for real-time sync. The biggest challenge was ensuring smooth performance during simultaneous editing by multiple users - I had to redesign the data structure and Firebase security rules several times.
The app maintains a 1MB size limit for efficiency, but easily handles ~200 participants in typical usage.
